authorization.operation_class: bounded local/remote recovery and authoritative-baseline reconciliation

status_summary: The unchanged local scaffold was reconciled with the previously empty private GitHub repository, generated/local state was excluded, an initial governed root commit was normally published to main, and local/upstream/remote identity was verified.

pre_reconciliation.local_git_state: An empty .git directory existed but contained no valid repository metadata.
pre_reconciliation.remote_state: empty; authenticated GitHub metadata returned Git Repository is empty and git ls-remote returned no heads or tags

mechanism: Initialized ordinary in-place Git metadata at the target workspace with git init -b main.
Created a root commit from the explicit authorized staged file set.
Published main through an ordinary non-force git push with upstream tracking.
git_recovery.sandbox_boundary: The session-visible empty .git entry was a protected metadata mount; the trusted host controller initialized the physical in-place .git at the same target workspace path, consistent with the GACP execution adapter.

baseline_adoption.semantics: The commit adopts the existing scaffold for continuity and provenance only. It does not grant substantive approval to product architecture, placeholder areas, names, comments, behavior, or design choices.

validation.name: prior-baseline-fingerprint
validation.evidence: The 30-file aggregate SHA-256 matched 4db8e311fb4ca1d623597596bc7b11e980c21eebb27bee66de6cf7cf1d79adee before reconciliation.

validation.name: remote-identity-and-emptiness
validation.evidence: Authenticated GitHub metadata and git ls-remote independently confirmed the exact private repository and no pre-existing heads or tags before publication.

validation.name: preserved-source-integrity
validation.evidence: All nine pre-existing files other than .gitignore retained their prior SHA-256 values; README.md and LICENSE remained intentionally empty placeholders.

validation.name: ignore-classification
validation.evidence: build/ and representative CMake, Ninja, compiled, .agents, and .codex paths matched the intended ignore rules and were absent from the commit.

validation.name: repository-local-governance-scope
validation.evidence: AGENTS.md is limited to GACP bootstrap, continuity semantics, generated-state exclusion, and authority limits; it introduces no substantive AV Studio architecture.

validation.name: build-check
validation.evidence: cmake, ninja, and a C++ compiler are not installed in the execution environment; the authorization forbids introducing dependencies.

validation.name: existing-binary-smoke
validation.evidence: The pre-existing ignored studio executable ran successfully and reported version 0.0.1 and successful engine initialization.

validation.name: staged-scope
validation.evidence: Exactly 11 authorized files were staged and committed; no generated build output or unrelated path was included.

validation.name: sensitive-and-machine-path-scan
validation.evidence: Candidate text contained no detected credentials, private-key markers, bearer tokens, machine-local absolute paths, or private conversational material.

validation.name: ordinary-publication
validation.evidence: A new origin/main was created by ordinary non-force push; no prior remote history existed.

validation.name: post-publication-synchronization
validation.evidence: Local HEAD, origin/main upstream, git ls-remote, and authenticated GitHub commit retrieval all resolved 6c6398ae69b0675cd322efda79a5f05619f29553; tracked status was clean.

target_publication.subject: Establish initial governed baseline
target_publication.push: ordinary non-force new main publication performed and verified

confirmed_exclusions: no substantive source redesign or feature implementation
no substantive README, license text, architecture, roadmap, project definition, or recovered design artifact
no third-party dependency or package-manager introduction
no force-push, history rewrite, branch deletion, destructive reset, or alternate Git metadata
no publication of private conversational history or machine-local paths
no change to another project repository
limitations: A source rebuild was infeasible because the execution environment lacks cmake, ninja, and a C++ compiler; no installation was authorized. The existing ignored executable smoke test passed.
Continuity adoption does not constitute substantive acceptance of the existing scaffold or prior design history.
next_gate: Owner substantive acceptance of the recovery/reconciliation result. Any design-history recovery, project-definition work, architecture decisions, license selection, scaffold revision, or feature implementation requires a separate authoritative GACP handoff.
